question: In which country was the World Snooker Championship 2020 held from 31 July to 16 August 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The World Snooker Championship 2020 was held from 31 July to 16 August 2020 in England**__.

 __
 
• It was the 44th consecutive year that the World Snooker Championship was held at the Crucible Theatre, England.
 
• It was **organized by the World Snooker Tour, a subsidiary of the World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The 2021 World Snooker Championship (also referred to as the 2021 Betfred World Snooker Championship for the purposes of sponsorship) was a professional snooker tournament, that took place from 17 April to 3 May 2021 at the Crucible Theatre in Sheffield, England.
